description:
Replication Lag Predictor — WARN0303

Detects DML write bursts in the slow log before lag appears in seconds_behind_master. Fires when DML count in window / window-mins >= write-rate-threshold queries/min.

config_keys.label: Observation window (minutes)
config_keys.help: Slow log entries older than this window are excluded from the DML rate calculation.

config_keys.label: DML write rate threshold (q/min)
config_keys.help: Fires when DML statements appear in the slow log at this rate or higher.
